data.one_liner: Widgets and slivers for rendering hierarchical tree structures and handling drag-and-drop.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of widgets and slivers to bring hierarchical data to life. It traverses data in depth-first order to lazily render tree nodes with customizable indentation guides, animations, and drag-and-drop support.
use_when: You need to display hierarchical file systems or directory trees in Flutter.
You want expandable and collapsible tree views with custom indentation lines.
You require tree nodes with drag-and-drop reordering capabilities.
avoid_when: You are using Flutter's built-in Material library directly without migrating to material_ui.
You don't have hierarchical or nested data structures to display.
strengths: Supports indentation guides, connect lines, and expand/collapse animations.
Includes rudimentary drag-and-drop support with auto-scrolling and auto-expanding nodes.
Efficiently renders tree nodes using slivers.
weaknesses: Requires migration to the standalone material_ui package in version 2.0.
Major breaking changes compared to older 1.x versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding material_ui: ^1.11.0 to dependencies and importing material_ui.dart instead of flutter/material.dart.
